definition: Cerebral hypoplasia is a structural brain abnormality in which the cerebrum is smaller or has less volume than expected on brain imaging. In this source, it is described as a neuroradiological finding seen in some children with Pallister-Killian syndrome, often discussed together with cerebral atrophy as part of cerebral volume loss.
